note: THE DIVERGENCE. Emacs signals `end-of-buffer'/`beginning-of-buffer' after moving as far as it can; kg clamps and answers nil. fe gates `signal' on its own condition table (fe_eval.c's condition_parents[]) and neither name is in it, so raising one would be an fe language change rather than a kg native -- and kg's own `forward-word' has clamped since sub-plan 03. Point ends in the same place on both sides, which is what the second element of each pair pins.
